resources.string: UltimateGallery needs access to your photos and videos to show them and to add watermarks in batch.
Works fully offline: the app has no network access at all.
No accounts, no analytics, nothing leaves your phone.
You can allow all media, or only some photos; allowing all is recommended.
Access is needed to show your gallery. You can allow it from the system settings.
Only the photos you selected are visible.
